items.quote: Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him.
items.contrast: Abishai, the rescuer and killer, versus David, the intended victim being rescued.
items.reason: The passage explicitly identifies Abishai as the person who struck down and killed the Philistine. Tracking the roles matters because David participates in the battle but does not perform this killing.
